functions.name: DefaultLookupPackage
functions.summary: DefaultLookupPackage is the default package lookup function, used when [Parser.LookupPackage] is nil. It recognizes names of the packages from the standard library with single-element import paths, such as math, which would otherwise be impossible to name.
